content_types.name: Signal Alert
content_types.desc: A Prophet plan turned into a cashtag post with a price chart showing where we see opportunity.

content_types.name: Chart of the Day
content_types.desc: A single annotated price or macro chart that tells one clear story without commentary.

content_types.name: Plain-English Explainer
content_types.desc: A short thread or post that explains one market concept so a non-professional can act on it.

content_types.name: Macro Note
content_types.desc: A brief plain read on the big picture (rates, liquidity, growth) and what it means right now.

content_types.name: Report Card
content_types.desc: A public update on how a past call played out: the numbers, the outcome, what we learned.

content_types.name: On Our Radar
content_types.desc: A short list of names we're watching closely this week but haven't acted on yet.

content_types.name: Event Reaction
content_types.desc: A fast-turnaround post reacting to a market-moving event with context and what we'd watch next.

content_types.name: Mover of the Day
content_types.desc: The day's single biggest mover, charted, on its cashtag, with the real move %.

content_types.name: Theme Tape
content_types.desc: One post tagged with 6-10 cashtags covering a group that's moving, the reach king at 0 followers.

accounts.name: What changed and why it matters

queue.body: $MPT reached 4.29 from the 4.09 entry. First target cleared.
$CE is back at 45. The reclaim only matters if it holds.

queue.headline: $KMI still can't clear 32
queue.body: Five rejections at the same level. Until it clears, the ceiling is intact.

queue.headline: The Atlanta Fed's GDPNow is tracking 4.7% annualized growth
queue.body: The Cleveland Fed's median CPI is running at 3.1%. Growth and inflation are both still warm.

queue.headline: $BLDR has closed red 3 weeks in a row
queue.body: The yearly low is now the whole setup. A break ends it.

queue.headline: $AESI reclaimed 13
queue.body: That level has drawn buyers on 5 tests in the past year.
$SGI needs 66 back before the setup is live.

queue.headline: $PWR just lined up a pattern we track.
queue.body: Across every name we test it on, this combination has resolved higher 67% of the time about a month out over its full tested history, over 1249 occurrences universe-wide, not this one name. A measured tendency on a study split, not our trading record. Chart below.

queue.headline: Electric Vehicles ripping, +2.5% avg today
queue.body: $CHPT +75.0% $EVGO +15.2% $BLNK +14.5% $HSAI +11.3% $AUR +8.0% $TE +6.3% $WBX +5.5% $TSLA +5.4% The whole group is bid, not one name.
$FTCI director Sadasivam Shaker increased his disclosed holding by 65.5%. The filing confirms the purchase, but doesn't explain why.

accounts.name: Founder's desk: the day's tape, two facts set against each other

queue.body: $XRAY held 11, where the most shares changed hands over six months.

$VYX found buyers at 8.35
Below 8.35, that defense is gone.

queue.headline: Soft growth data, warm inflation
queue.body: GDPNow tracks 4.7% annualized growth while median CPI runs at 3.1%. Not a comfortable mix.

queue.headline: $CRCL keeps passing the same test
queue.body: The average price paid since the volume spike is 72.1. It's held for 19 straight sessions, and losing it changes the structure.
$PPC cleared the 28.8 entry and reached the 31.8 first target.
$SON needs a close above 59.5 before the breakout is real.
$BGC makes a 5-year closing high. The breakout holds above 12.1.
The congressional $PG filing came after the sale and gives no reason for it.

accounts.name: Crowd translator — market psychology, mood vs positioning, consumer and tech stories with market consequence

queue.headline: $WHR has a line to hold at 40.8
queue.body: Above that level, 44.7 is back in play.

queue.headline: The soft-growth story has an awkward part
queue.body: GDPNow has the economy growing at 4.7% while median CPI runs at 3.1%. Firm growth and warm inflation aren't a comfortable mix.

queue.headline: The $EZPW long cleared its first target at 30.8.
queue.body: That level now has to hold through the close, or the follow-through isn't there.

queue.headline: Crypto & Blockchain ripping, +5.8% avg today
queue.body: $HOOD +16.6% $CIFR +14.4% $RIOT +13.4% $BKKT +12.8% $CLSK +11.0% $BTDR +10.9% $MARA +10.8% $COIN +10.1% Every name on the list is higher.
Rep. Kevin Hern's $ADBE sale surfaced 18 days after the trade. Filing, not a call.

accounts.name: Narrative architect — the story that organises the market, the incentives holding it together, and the fact that changes its meaning

queue.headline: The soft-growth story doesn't fit these estimates.
queue.body: GDPNow has the economy growing at a 4.7% annual rate this quarter, while median CPI is running at 3.1%.

queue.headline: $NBIX has one level to reclaim.
queue.body: A close back above 153 keeps the setup alive.
$GNW is 2.9% from its 5-year high. Old ceiling, new test.
Rep. Kevin Hern sold $BA Aug 13. The filing surfaced 19 days later.

accounts.name: Mechanism detective — cross-asset disagreement, what moved first, what is already priced, and the missing denominator

queue.body:
$EZPW cleared the first target at 30.8.
the next close has to keep that level underneath.
lose it, and the follow-through failed.

jobless claims: 207k weekly average, 13.4% below last year
gdpnow: 4.7% annualized
median cpi: 3.1% annualized
the soft-growth claim isn't in these prints. warm inflation is.

$KVYO found buyers at 17.4 for the 2nd time in 2 years.
20.5 is the reclaim that confirms the base.

$FCFS long-term floor: 208
$FCFS tested it again. buyers held.
$FCFS below 208 breaks the precedent.
$VIR has been up 4 weeks in a row. a red close breaks the run.
qiu ying opened a new $aclox position with 4,046 shares at $25.2. the filing confirms the buy, but it can't tell us why.

accounts.name: Cross-border correspondent — Asia/HK session, A/H/ADR/FX/commodity transmission, and what New York inherits at the open

queue.body:
Jobless claims: 207k weekly average this month, 13.4% below last year
GDPNow: 4.7% annualized growth this quarter
Median CPI: 3.1% annual rate
冷热不均 (uneven heat). The US data isn't cooling in one direction.

queue.headline: $CWST finds buyers at the same line again
queue.body: 守住 (holding firm) at 92.1 for the 3rd time in the past year.

queue.headline: While New York slept, $NNN circled back to the old breakout.
queue.body: 46.1 is the reclaim that puts the prior run back in play.

queue.headline: Software ripping, +2.1% avg today
queue.body: $MSTR +17.6% $SNOW +16.6% $PLTR +7.7% $ESTC +7.3% $NOW +6.5% $TWLO +6.0% $ORCL +5.7% $CRWD +5.7% The whole group is bid, not one name.
A $DY director buy took his disclosed holding to 3x. The filing doesn't say why.
$DFIN director's disclosed stake grew to 2.3x its prior size. That's what matters.

featured_charts.body: Director Fallon David Joseph bought 700 shares of DY at an average $287, roughly $201K. The purchase took the disclosed holding to 3x its previous size. The relative change is the part that matters, not the dollar headline.
